name: statue-press
description: THE STATUE PIN. A driver-planned approach with a HAND-AUTHORED tail: botDriverV2 walks to (168,184) — tile (10,11), the cell directly west of the statue at oel (184,160) — and then RIGHT is held for 40 ticks straight into its left edge. The driver cannot produce the press itself: its whole job is to never touch a wall, and tile (11,11) is not even a legal goal because the player box does not fit at its centre. This exists because the statue was the one entity in the class table carrying TWO constructor offsets — Statue's (+16,-8) on top of NPC's (+8,+8) — and slice 1 applied only the first, putting the collider 8 px up and left. Nothing caught it until a pathing fixture walked past. With the route now planned AROUND the statue, this is the fixture that puts the corrected rect back under the oracle: the pinned x is a direct measurement of the collider's left edge, and the 8 px error moves it.
